summary: Star Fashion Culture Holdings filed a Form 6-K confirming the September 28, 2026 closing of a best-efforts offering of 12,000,000 Class A Ordinary Shares at $0.80 per share, for gross proceeds of roughly $9.6 million. The shares were sold to several purchasers under Securities Purchase Agreements and registered on Form F-1 (No. 333-298981), declared effective September 24, 2026. Kingswood Capital Partners acted as placement agent for a 6.5% cash fee plus a 0.6% non-accountable expense reimbursement. Proceeds fund online marketing services, general administration and working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and post-deal trading liquidity.
